text: The group defined that FIE073 will deliver a written plan covering functional and technical design, staffing, timeframe, budget, and market plan by two weeks.
Ed will coordinate with Christine to discuss cost and the sales plan as part of preparing the overall plan.
There was a scope/goal misalignment as ID(FIE073) did not understand the project goal and believed the project was a different product.
The group decided that the project will focus on designing a remote control for television and will start with that remote control as the first product.
The project manager will send a copy of the slides to all attendees at the conclusion of the meeting.
